chunks: For those who obey their Lord is excellence. For those who fail to obey, the reckoning will be hard, even if they possess and give as ransom all that there is on the earth, and as much more; and Hell will be their abode: How wretched is its wide expanse!
ai.seo_question: What is the fate of those who do not obey their Lord according to Surah Ar-Ra'd?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the ultimate insufficiency of material wealth against divine justice, illustrating that the 'evil reckoning' (Su' al-Hisab) is a direct consequence of rejecting the truth despite clear signs. The contrast between 'the best reward' (Al-Husna) for the responsive and the 'evil resting place' (Bi'sa al-Mihad) for the stubborn underscores the spiritual bankruptcy of those who prioritize worldly accumulation over divine covenant.
